say:4:1010514001:0.text: Welcome, my distinguished guests, and thank you for gracing my home with your presence this evening. My name is Franz.
say:4:1010514001:0.source_cn: 感谢诸位贵宾今日拨冗光临敝庄，在下弗朗茨。

say:5:1010514002:0.text: As you can all see, these are Gemvine grapes, a special variety that can only be produced in these lands.
say:5:1010514002:0.source_cn: 想必诸位都看见了，\n唯有这方水土才能养育的独特葡萄—...

say:6:1010514003:0.text: Now, allow me to present the masterpiece of tonight's banquet. Our most unique brew, crafted using only the best Gemvine grapes!
say:6:1010514003:0.source_cn: 现在，请允许我为诸位呈上今夜的珍宝！没错，正是由藤水晶...

say:7:1010514004:0.text: Tonight, everyone attending the Golden Banquet will have the opportunity to savor it.
say:7:1010514004:0.source_cn: 今夜，参加黄金晚宴的诸位都将品尝到它。

say:8:1010514005:0.text: At our current capacity, we can produce twenty thousand casks of brew per year. More than enough to fill the goblets of every noble in the royal capital, I'm sure!
say:8:1010514005:0.source_cn: 按照现在的产量，我们每年可以生产两万桶，足以供应王都所...

say:9:1010514006:0.text: Please believe me when I say this brew has the potential to add even more flavor to your lives!
say:9:1010514006:0.source_cn: 请诸位相信，这美味的藤水晶，必将为诸位今后的生活增光添彩！

say:11:1010514007:0.text: Oh? From what I've heard, bad weather resulted in awful harvests across the region. Northville's wheat and Southville's Gemvine grapes were both affected.
say:11:1010514007:0.source_cn: 哦？但……我最近听说，由于气候异变，别说是北村的小麦了...

say:12:1010514008:0.text: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?
say:12:1010514008:0.source_cn: 梅林的加护，是否已经不再庇护这片土地了？未来，你还能继...
say:12:1010514008:0.male: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?
say:12:1010514008:0.female: Could it be that Merlin's ward no longer works? In the future, will you still be able to grow these Gemvine grapes in Ryeham?

say:13:1010514009:0.text: No, milady... These are just rumors! Yes, that's it! Baseless, fear-mongering rumors, and nothing more!
say:13:1010514009:0.source_cn: 不不不……夫人，这是流言……不！是谎言！是彻头彻尾的谎言。

say:14:1010514010:0.text: With the decades-long disappearance of Merlin, it's only natural that the protection over Ryeham has been compromised. But I can assure you it has not affected me in the least!
say:14:1010514010:0.source_cn: 大魔法师梅林失踪了几十年，金穗村的加护受到影响，一点也...

say:15:1010514011:0.text: Hmm... Perhaps so, but Southville's output isn't nearly enough to sustain your grandiose promises.
say:15:1010514011:0.source_cn: 呵……就算如此，光靠南村那点产量根本不够。你在说大话。

say:16:1010514012:0.text: I have already spoken to the residents of Northville, my lady. They will begin sowing our grapes as soon as the weather allows. No need to worry.
say:16:1010514012:0.source_cn: 夫人，我们已经说服北村的村民了，他们近些天便会铲掉麦田...

say:20:1010514013:0.text: That jerk, I can't believe he's...
say:20:1010514013:0.source_cn: 这个混球，果然一开始就——

narration:22:10106221:0.text: The banquet officially begins as Lord Franz and the guests enter.
narration:22:10106221:0.source_cn: 弗朗茨和宾客们相继入场，宴会正式开始。
